title: Repeated calls to unchanged models show response variation relevant to update certification
summary: Batching tests found substantial response-content variation, establishing a measured reproducibility floor separate from update certification. The result is specific to the evaluated models and batching conditions and does not establish that a particular update was incorrectly certified.
ai_technology: The study compares language models before and after updates, defines declared input regions for intended changes, and tests how much behavior changes outside those regions.
